read.thesis: Chubb's Q1 CY26 P&C combined ratio of 84.0% and core EPS of $6.82 look strong, but management cut Major Accounts and E&S property (large account property down 55%) as property and financial lines soften, so supply is shrinking while pricing softens.

triggers.label: Large account property down 55%
triggers.quote: large account property, which was down 55.0% due to market conditions

triggers.label: Property and financial lines softening
triggers.quote: Both property and financial lines insurance market conditions are soft or softening, with portions of the property market softening at a rapid pace.

triggers.label: Q1 cat losses $500M vs $1.64B
triggers.quote: Total pre-tax net catastrophe losses were $500 million compared with $1.64 billion last year

guidance.metric: Growth in operating earnings and EPS
guidance.value: double-digit EPS growth; strong operating earnings growth
guidance.quote: we remain confident in our ability to continue generating strong growth in operating earnings, and double-digit growth in EPS and tangible book value.

red_flags.label: Soft property and financial lines pricing
red_flags.quote: Given inadequate price levels, we moved during the quarter to reduce exposures
